translations.web: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.
translations.bsb: You did not anoint My head with oil, but she has anointed My feet with perfume.
translations.kjv: My head with oil thou didst not anoint: but this woman hath anointed my feet with ointment.
